page: OVHcloud a100-180 is an accelerated cloud instance from the Cloud GPU family, provisioned on KVM virtualization. The instance integrates 15 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs operating at 3.0 GHz with 180.0 GB of system memory, establishing a high memory density of 12.0 GB per vCPU. Computational acceleration is delivered by a single NVIDIA A100 GPU based on the Ampere architecture, equipped with 80 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM to support memory-heavy parallel computations.

The host configuration bundles 300 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and provides an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile. The instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Because local storage is limited to 300 GB, workflows handling multi-terabyte datasets must account for secondary network or object storage integrations for bulk data staging.

By coupling 80 GB of GPU memory with 180 GB of host RAM, the instance avoids host-memory bottlenecks during data preparation and tensor offloading. This architecture provides cost-effective resource utilization for operations that require extensive GPU memory without necessitating multi-GPU nodes. The hardware configuration fits large language model inference, deep learning model fine-tuning, scientific simulations, and GPU-accelerated data processing.
